about: The standard words of the notice bar for tools/close_today.py. Placeholders: {weekday} {date} (the day), {weekday2} {date2} (the last day of a run), {time}. The tool fills them in each language (weekday and month words come from tools/date_phrases.py). Edit a sentence here and the next closure uses it. Keep every placeholder and do not use < > \ or straight double quotes.
native_read_note: false means the sentences were written by an AI and no native speaker has read them yet (same as the translations on the site: docs/QUESTIONS_FOR_THE_FARM.md, d37). Set a language to true here when someone has read it.
